description.message: Sends your claude.ai and ChatGPT chats to the Interlatch dashboard on this computer as you use the sites.

stSavingDetail.message: They go only to Interlatch on this computer.

stWaitingDetail.message: Open claude.ai or chatgpt.com to start saving chats.

stPausedDetail.message: No chats are read or sent until you turn this off.

stStoppedDetail.message: Start it with this command, then open this again.

stInstallDetail.message: This extension saves your chats into Interlatch, an app on your computer. It needs Interlatch to work.

portHint.message: On another port? Set it in Settings.

howItWorks.message: Chats are read while a claude.ai or chatgpt.com tab is open: every 5 minutes, and soon after you leave a chat. Older chats come in from a data export (Sources in the dashboard). Click for the guide.

siteNotYet.message: Not synced yet: open or reload a tab

siteSlowed.message: Catching up: $1 saved so far. The site asked to slow down, so it goes on in a few minutes

noTab.message: No claude.ai or chatgpt.com tab answered. Reload one: a tab opened before the extension was loaded doesn't have it yet.

daysLabel.message: Days the first sync goes back

resetTitle.message: Forget what was sent: the next sync goes back the days above again

errNotRunning.message: the Interlatch dashboard is not running at $1

errTimeout.message: the Interlatch dashboard at $1 didn't answer within a minute

errUpdate.message: update Interlatch: this dashboard can't take chats yet

errReloaded.message: the extension was reloaded: reload this tab

ovCatching.message: Saving your chats. The first sync can take a while.

resMore.message: $1 saved so far, and more to come

resError.message: It stopped: the site above says why

ovNoticeSaving.message: Saving this site's chats. They go only to the dashboard on this computer.

ovNoticePaused.message: Paused: no chats are read or sent.

stConsentDetail.message: Nothing is read until you choose to start.

wlIntro.message: This extension saves your claude.ai and ChatGPT chats into Interlatch, an app on your computer, so you can search them and find them again.

wlReads.message: Your chats on claude.ai and chatgpt.com, with their titles, messages and project names, using your own sign-in. Temporary chats are left out. It reads nothing on other sites.

wlGoes.message: Only to the Interlatch dashboard on this computer (127.0.0.1). The extension sends your chats nowhere else, and Interlatch's authors never receive them.

wlThen.message: Interlatch keeps them on this computer and doesn't analyze them on its own. If you choose to analyze a chat, a condensed copy goes to the AI model you set up in Interlatch.

wlStop.message: Pause any time from the toolbar button or the message on the page, or remove the extension. Chats already saved stay in Interlatch until you delete them there.

wlNeeds.message: Interlatch isn't running on this computer yet, and the extension needs it.

wlStarted.message: Saving is on. Open claude.ai or chatgpt.com, or reload a tab that's already open.

wlLaterDone.message: Nothing is being read. You can start any time from the toolbar button.
